verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT ships with a substantial vendor software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD Software), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability for it, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official MCP server for the card, ROCm or AMD Software. The llms.txt file on the ROCm docs site is an adjacent documentation feature, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
